prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tileable raster texture for a 2D historical strategy-game map background. Create an original, restrained Han-era-inspired pale silk and handmade paper texture, tactile and historical while quiet enough that small dark Chinese city labels, blue rivers, roads, and character tokens stay legible. Matte archival silk-paper blend, subtle natural fibers, faint hand-made grain, original design rather than imitation of a commercial game. Edge-to-edge uniform texture with no focal point, frame, or border. Muted warm parchment, light khaki, pale tea, extremely faint cool-gray fibers, low contrast and saturation. Flat diffuse light. No text, characters, calligraphy, stamps, map outlines, rivers, mountains, cities, roads, icons, people, objects, watermark, logo, folds, tears, holes, burned edges, heavy stains, vignette, high-frequency noise, highlights, or geographic shapes.

processing.runtime: drawn once into the static terrain cache; classic_daylight alpha 0.065 and antique_topographic alpha 0.055; no drag-time redraw
